content.rationale: S3-restore fixes the write half — restore a whole deccy operation via `op restore` given the boundary's operation id, no partial/file-level/snapshot restore; M-layout places the module flat at src/restore.rs. It names the operation and crosses `jj op restore <id>` through the runner (M-jj), returning the crossing's outcome; which boundary to restore is the undo/redo layer's concern.
